en.name: Pedant
en.ability: Once per game, the Demon may visit the Storyteller and guess that you are the Pedant. If correct, even if you're dead, the Demon may choose a player that night: they die. The Demon knows a Pedant is in play.

zh.name: 书生
zh.ability: 恶魔知道书生在场。每局游戏限一次，恶魔可以拜访说书人并猜测你是书生。如果恶魔猜测正确，即使你已死亡，当晚该恶魔可以选择一名玩家：他死亡。
